item.title: School starts soon in Lebanon but thousands still shelter in them during war
item.description: Families sheltering in a school in Lebanon's city of Tyre are some of the hundreds of thousands of people displaced by the latest conflict between Israel and Hezbollah

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln sails past Singapore on its way home from Middle East
item.description: The U.S. aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln has sailed past Singapore as it heads home

item.title: Rescue efforts intensify after Nepal-Tibet flooding as deaths climb past 900
item.description: Rescuers are trying to find trapped workers in hydroelectric plant tunnels after catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet killed at least 900 people and left more than 4,700 missing

item.title: Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda agree to work together on software for cars
item.description: Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda are going to jointly develop computer parts and software for vehicles set to enter the market in fiscal 2029

item.title: Russia's jet-powered drones bring empty Kyiv supermarket shelves
item.description: Russian forces have relentlessly battered Kyiv and nearby cities for a fifth straight day, hitting warehouse facilities as Ukraine reels from attacks with jet-powered drones

item.title: Pakistan will award nurse for saving sole newborn survivor of hospital nursery fire
item.description: A Pakistani nurse who rescued the sole surviving newborn from a hospital fire that killed 14 other infants will receive one of the country’s top civil awards
